author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
An Open Conversation with Dr. Desirée Plata and Dr. Chris Raben Hosted by Curt Newton

Understanding the connections between climate, energy, and economic growth is critical to shaping a future where thriving communities and economic prosperity are no longer tied to greenhouse gas emissions. How can we think differently about climate, energy, and cross-sector solutions that build resilience, support adaptation, and create a healthier, more prosperous and equitable future for all?

Join Dr. Desirée Plata, Dr. Chris Rabe, and Curt Newton from MIT Open Learning for an engaging conversation about what climate and energy actions are needed now and how education can empower people to make informed decisions and drive meaningful change.

During this conversation, the team will share the vision behind Universal Climate and Energy, an effort designed to bridge climate and energy knowledge with real-world application. They will discuss how the program will prepare learners for impactful careers
title: Building Climate and Energy Resilience through Education Live Webcast
